newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - National Grid upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - National Grid upgraded.

text.p: Goldman Sachs has raised its long term stance on National Grid to "outperform" from "market perform" and raised earnings estimates after the latest price control proposals from industry regulator OFFER, market sources said on Friday.

Goldman is said to feel that Thursday's recommendation by OFFER of an initial 20 percent cut followed by a cap on price increases of four points below inflation were at the benign end of expectations and should be accepted by the company. In early trading, shares in National Grid were 1/2p lower at 177-1/2p.

While short term share performance may be held back by uncertainty over whether National Grid will accept OFFER"s proposals or opt for an inquiry by the Monopolies and Mergers Commission and fears about a windfall tax, Goldman believe the stock is undervalued at current levels.
It has raised earnings per share estimates by an average of seven percent from 1998 through to 2000, the period of OFFER's review.
"Goldman's forecasts include 200 million stg for a windfall tax but given the uncertainty its really a long term stance on the stock," said the market source.
